research_question: In patients with uremic (chronic kidney disease-associated) pruritus, what is the effect of kappa-opioid receptor agonists (e.g. difelikefalin, nalbuphine, nalfurafine) compared with placebo on pruritus severity measured on a 0-10 cm visual analogue scale (VAS), based on parallel-group studies?
treatment_label: Kappa-opioid receptor agonist (difelikefalin, nalbuphine, nalfurafine, or other kappa agonist), pooled as one drug class
outcome_description: Pruritus (itch) severity rated on a 0-10 cm visual analogue scale (VAS), where 0 = no itch and 10 = worst imaginable itch. Endpoint or change-from-baseline VAS itch scores in participants with uremic/CKD-associated pruritus, extracted as means with SDs (or convertible statistics) for the kappa-opioid agonist and placebo arms.
positive_direction: A positive Mean Difference indicates that the kappa-opioid agonist reduced pruritus severity more than placebo (i.e. lower VAS itch scores, less itching, a better outcome for the treatment group).
search_queries: difelikefalin uremic pruritus randomized placebo-controlled trial
nalbuphine nalfurafine kappa opioid agonist itch hemodialysis trial
kappa opioid receptor agonist chronic kidney disease associated pruritus visual analogue scale effect
inclusion_criteria: Participants with uremic / chronic kidney disease-associated pruritus (including hemodialysis or peritoneal dialysis patients)
Evaluates a kappa-opioid receptor agonist (e.g. difelikefalin, nalbuphine, nalfurafine, or similar) against a placebo or control condition
Reports some quantitative itch/pruritus severity outcome, preferably a VAS-type itch score, for both groups
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic review, meta-analysis, narrative review, editorial, opinion piece, case report, or purely theoretical/modelling paper)
No comparison between a kappa-opioid agonist treatment condition and a placebo/control condition
No quantitative outcome data from which an effect size can be computed (no means with SDs/SEs, t/F values, CIs, proportions, or odds ratios)
Crossover-design studies, or topic completely unrelated to kappa-opioid agonists for uremic pruritus
moderators_to_extract: Specific kappa-opioid agonist drug and dose
Dialysis modality and baseline pruritus severity
Risk of bias / blinding and funding source
effect_size_note: All included studies use the same 0-10 cm VAS pruritus scale, so results are pooled as a raw Mean Difference (MD) in VAS units rather than a standardized measure. Effects are signed so that a positive MD favors the kappa-opioid agonist (greater reduction in VAS itch score). Only parallel-group designs are pooled; crossover studies and the fixed-effects sensitivity analysis are handled in separate analyses of this review. All kappa-opioid agonist drugs are pooled together as a single drug class (no per-drug subgroups), with random-effects pooling.
